name: guardrail_verify
description: Pre-execution security gate to detect prompt injection, destructive bash commands, wallet drain, and key exfiltration.

payload.description: Command, script, or prompt to inspect

name: mcp_rugpull_diff
description: Detects mid-session MCP tools/list rug-pulls, shadow parameter injections, and coercive description mutations.

name: mcp_sampling_guard
description: Audits inbound MCP sampling/createMessage requests to block systemPrompt hijacking and recursive quota drain.

name: tool_output_firewall
description: Sanitizes untrusted tool outputs, stripping invisible Unicode tags (U+E0000), markdown exfiltration beacons, and indirect prompt injections.

name: agent_loop_circuit_breaker
description: Analyzes recent tool-call traces to trip a circuit breaker on cyclic retries, A/B deadlocks, and runaway token burn.

name: sql_injection_ast_guard
description: Statically validates LLM-generated SQL queries via AST inspection to block SQLi tautologies, UNION leaks, and DROP/TRUNCATE.

name: code_sandbox
description: Executes untrusted Python snippets inside an ephemeral sandbox with static AST safety auditing.

code.description: Python code to audit and run

name: scrub_pii_firewall
description: Redacts emails, SSNs, phone numbers, API keys, and wallet seed phrases before external LLM calls.
